name: Last Stop: Murder
tagline: A luxury sleeper, a snowdrift, and a passenger who will never reach Istanbul.
description: Mahogany, velvet and silver service, stalled in the snow halfway across Europe. A wealthy passenger has been found dead in a locked compartment, and every traveller aboard has a reason to lie.
artStyle: 1930s travel poster, art deco locomotive, snowy mountains, warm carriage lamplight
